lines.text: 🚨 Cliffhanger, Sunbasker, The Anaconda Empress, The Anaconda Empress is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
📓 Codex: Cliffhanger, Sunbasker, The Anaconda Empress, The Anaconda Empress at the door, day 9.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Cliffhanger: Go for the eyes. When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Go for the eyes — When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus.
🛡️ Morgan, Gloria, Yuraq and Abaynesh met them at the door — 4 driven off. Morgan, Gloria, Abaynesh are hurt.
One of them is coming for YOU — Cliffhanger, inside the haven, eyes on your bedroll.
A lean scout waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
🚶 A stranger walks into Haven. They're thin, scared, and carrying nothing. "Please," they say. "I heard you have food." (Drama: do you share?)
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 35. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 3."
★ IDENTIFIED: Cassava. Shrub, thick roots. The roots are food ONLY after proper processing. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Oh! It has a NAME. You all love names.
Lena was watching. Now they know Cassava too.
📚 Village knowledge: Gloria taught everyone about Cassava. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1100 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🩹 Lena makes rounds — Morgan gets bound up properly. (47 → 62 HP)

Aria has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: Gloria passes around Cassava. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
Morgan: "The cowpea patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."
🔍 Marcus crouches over a low plant with tiny white flowers, studying it a moment before moving on. (1/3 looks)
Marcus traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Abaynesh and Morgan lingered over the fire together.
Ella and Aria lingered over the fire together.
Lena and Ella lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Marcus weighs the day's basket against the pantry shelves and puts it down. "Enough. Carving bowls instead — we're down to the cracked ones."
🍽️ Lena sets the sharing basket down by the fire instead of the pantry. "Full shelves don't need my little more."
📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 2). Predators test: they approach, watch, decide. Prey freezes or bolts. Learn which you're looking at.
📖 LEARNED: Haymaker (Level 2). The big swing always lands where it hurts.
📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 2). Clean cuts, no waste — the carcass gives everything.
🌟 JACKPOT: A stranger by the road knows things. They talk for an hour. You learn: Animal Behavior, Haymaker, Field Dressing. Your Codex overflows.
You carry a message from Chloe to Marcus. It's not kind. You deliver it anyway. That's what neighbors do, apparently.
Gloria corners you by the fire: "Don't share your haul with Yuraq." It's not a request.
— DAY 10 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Cassava — named and noted.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. Two knobs on glass-still water, watching. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ CLIFFHANGER! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")

📺 +5 style — solid hit
💥 mugger's attack finds you — no dodging it.

📖 Codex: Cliffhanger Drag — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.

The Cliffhanger stalks closer. It has your leg. The roll starts. Do NOT let it reach the water.
💥 mugger's Cliffhanger Drag finds you — no dodging it.
Mugger's Cliffhanger Drag hits you for 14.
You go down.
📖 The Codex settles deeper into you. It knows things before you do now. Deaths, especially — it will tell you itself.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Maureen Bailey is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Maureen Bailey is dead — combat. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Morgan blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Maureen Bailey, 10 days. The mantle passes to Morgan Burns.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Morgan Burns, 22 — a glazier. Their hands know different work now: The Touch.
The fire knew Morgan — solid ground, earned at this fire.
Nothing to eat. The pantry of your pack is empty.
Took Dried beans.

📋 Gloria — 💧 Fetch water. They'll report back by next part.
Unequipped Bow.
🌱 Aria waters and weeds the beds before taking up other work. The harvest can wait.

🌿 Aria checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~8 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 Aria hauls back 6 wood. The pile grows. (106 logs now.)
💧 Abaynesh returns with 8L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
💧 Gloria returns with 5L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
You catch fragments by the fire — Gloria telling Ella about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
Marcus sets out to find Chloe. "Won't be long."
🌿 Chloe returns from foraging the wilds: +101 kcal to the pantry — the shelves are full, so 101 kcal is eaten at the fire instead.
Sigrun is sweeping ash and grit out through the door, steady strokes.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
🪨 Abaynesh pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (17 stone now.)
🩹 Abaynesh is hurting (60 HP) — Lena patches them up before they head out. (60 → 85 HP)
Abaynesh heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
The door is quiet. Haven breathes.
◈ CRISIS — THE SIEGE. They came in the night for the pantry — and the village met them at the door with blades and fire and drove them back into the dark. Wealth has a scent. So does defiance.
SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."
🛟 Yuraq stands up by the fire. "We can't just watch this happen. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"Tend the hurt, stretch the food, or hunt it back — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"Or we rally," Yuraq adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
📓 Codex: Yuraq proposed relief (raid), day 10.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Travel 1 tile to creek.
You catch fragments by the fire — Aria telling Sigrun about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to trail edge.
